title: Grade Report
description:
Read a student's name and three test scores from input. Calculate and print the average score (rounded to 1 decimal place) and the letter grade: A (90+), B (80+), C (70+), D (60+), F (below 60).

**Example (inputs: `Bob`, `85`, `92`, `78`):**
```
Student: Bob
Average: 85.0
Grade: B
```
starterCode:
# Write your code here
name = input()
score1 = float(input())
score2 = float(input())
score3 = float(input())
hint: Average = (s1 + s2 + s3) / 3. Use if/elif for the letter grade.
